dashboard.title: Administration
dashboard.intro: Review approvals, verification, disputes, and other high-risk operations queues.

exports.title: Data exports
exports.intro: Bulk exports require step-up MFA and approval from a second administrator before they run.

users.title: User approvals
users.intro: New accounts waiting for staff approval.

verifications.title: Tutor verification review
verifications.intro: Review pending tutor verifications and uploaded documents.

support.title: Support tickets
support.intro: Open support tickets across the platform.

suspensions.title: Tutor suspensions
suspensions.intro: Active tutor suspensions and the ability to create or lift one.

discounts.title: Discounts
discounts.intro: Create and manage promotional and manual discounts.

deletions.title: Deletions & privacy requests
deletions.intro: Mass deletion jobs require step-up MFA and a second administrator's approval. Legal-retention records are never deleted by this workflow.
deletions.cannotSelfApprove: You requested this deletion job — a different administrator must approve it.

roles.title: Role elevation
roles.intro: Role elevation requires step-up MFA and approval from a different super-administrator.
roles.cannotSelfApprove: You requested this role elevation — a different super-administrator must approve it.

security.title: Security settings
security.intro: Disabling a security control requires step-up MFA and approval from a different super-administrator.
security.cannotSelfApprove: You requested this change — a different super-administrator must approve it.

auditLog.title: Audit log
auditLog.intro: The append-only trail of every sensitive action taken on the platform.
auditLog.stepUpRequired: Re-verify with your authenticator app to view the audit log.
